name: PhishStats API
tier_rationale: Small identifiable operator with public terms and documentation (A8 community): 'PhishStats is a small identifiable operator with public terms: tier community.' (P074 chair rationale).

reliability.justification: Automated phishing collection with an ML phishscore: useful coverage, false positives on shared platforms and dynamic-DNS hosts; a record is a URL-level verdict only (P071 verdict scope).

error_markers.reason: PhishStats: rate limit message inside an HTTP 200 answer

api.title: PhishStats phishing URL search /api/phishing?_where=(host|ip,eq,...)|(url,like,~kw~)&_sort=-id&_size<=100

terms.quote: Terms: PhishStats licenses use 'for lawful security research, threat intelligence, and related purposes' (verified 2026-11-26): open, recorded in the registry. URLs are never submitted (submissions are redistributed to the community, rule 7).

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P074 cond 2). Research C0165 (verified_live). api.phishstats.info only (the phishstats.info:2096 host is unusable behind HTTPS-only proxies). _where filters are URL-encoded, exact host/ip filters first; an invalid filter is silently ignored and returns unrelated records with HTTP 200, so every record is re-checked against the filter. Limits: 20 req/min (RateLimit headers), anonymous 50/day per egress IP (quota block, 80% margin), cache 1 h of the redacted records only, result cap 100. Victims' e-mails and token-like values in result URLs are redacted before anything is stored (P074 cond 3). The submission endpoint is never used.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G03-1 (P074 phishstats). The 'host' field of a record is the registrable domain (workers.dev for *.workers.dev): shared-platform hosts are searched with a LIKE on the FQDN and filtered locally.
